channel.title: World
channel.description: The Washington Post World section provides information and analysis of breaking world news stories. In addition to our world news and video, Post World News offers discussions and blogs on major international news and economic issues.

item.title: Spain pushes migrants back to Morocco as suspicions swirl over mass border breach
item.dc:creator: Dalila Olmo López, Anthony Faiola, Mohamad El Chamaa
item.description: The crisis in Ceuta, on the African coast, instantly became a touchstone in the global migrant debate as suspicions swirled that the viral incident was orchestrated.

item.title: Zelensky says Ukraine has ‘no interceptors’ as ballistic missiles hit Kyiv
item.dc:creator: David Stern, Kostiantyn Khudov, Serhii Korolchuk, Serhiy Morgunov
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky had appealed for American air-defense missiles during a White House meeting on Tuesday.

item.title: U.S. general warns Pentagon he lacks sufficient forces to protect Israel
item.dc:creator: Dan Lamothe
item.description: A shortage of Navy destroyers, used to defend against Iranian ballistic missile attacks, will force the head of U.S. European Command to prioritize the U.S. homeland instead, officials said.
